enterNamePrompt: Enter your name for the leaderboard!
noScores: No scores yet. Be the first!
nameValidationError: Name must be at least 3 characters.
nameInappropriateError: This name is not allowed. Please choose another one.
regularModeDesc: Answer questions to score points. You have 3 lives. The game ends when you run out of lives.
timeAttackModeDesc: Score as many points as you can in 60 seconds. There are no lives, so speed is key!
beatTheClockModeDesc: Start with 30 seconds. Correct answers add time, but incorrect answers subtract it. How long can you last?
aboutAppDescription: A fun and simple game designed to help young learners practice and improve their math skills in an engaging way.
builtWithLove: Built with ❤️ for young learners everywhere.
author: by Dieter Balmer
privacyPolicyText: We take your privacy seriously. This app is designed to be safe for all ages. All game data, including your score and leaderboard name, is stored only on your own device in your browser's local storage. No data is ever sent to or stored on any external servers. Your information never leaves your computer.
